description:
Responsibilities
 •      Create physics-based algorithms for OPIR data processing and exploitation
 •      Develop software to support image processing pipelines
 •      Apply data analysis and visualization methods to algorithm results
 •      Closely collaborate with hardware developers, other software developers, and project leaders to develop, deploy, and evaluate software
 •      Prepare technical reports and presentations
 •      Communicate findings and status updates to project leaders, team members, and customers

 Required Qualifications
 •      BA/BS in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering
 •      Active Secret Clearance
 •      5+ years experience with software development on DoW/IC programs
 •      Experience with Python
 •      Experience with systems programming languages (e.g. C++, Rust)
 •      Experience with embedded software development

 Preferred Qualifications
 •      MA/MS in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering
 •      TS/SCI eligibility
 •      Experience with OPIR missions on DoW/IC programs
 •      Experience with embedded software development
 •      Experience with FPGA architectures
 •      Experience with AI/ML/agent workflows
 •      Experience with detection & tracking algorithms
  
 
 Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
